1: /**
2:  * Coding capability language server configurations.
3:  */
4: 
5: export interface LSPServerConfig {
6:   name: string;
7:   language: string;
8:   extensions: string[];
9:   command: string;
10:   args: string[];
11:   installHint: string;
12: }
13: 
14: export const BUILTIN_LSP_SERVERS: LSPServerConfig[] = [
15:   {
16:     name: "typescript",
17:     language: "typescript",
18:     extensions: [".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx"],
19:     command: "typescript-language-server",
20:     args: ["--stdio"],
21:     installHint: "npm install -g typescript-language-server typescript",
22:   },
23:   {
24:     name: "python",
25:     language: "python",
26:     extensions: [".py"],
27:     command: "pylsp",
28:     args: [],
29:     installHint: "pip install python-lsp-server",
30:   },
31:   {
32:     name: "go",
33:     language: "go",
34:     extensions: [".go"],
35:     command: "gopls",
36:     args: ["serve"],
37:     installHint: "go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest",
38:   },
39:   {
40:     name: "rust",
41:     language: "rust",
42:     extensions: [".rs"],
43:     command: "rust-analyzer",
44:     args: [],
45:     installHint: "rustup component add rust-analyzer",
46:   },
47:   {
48:     name: "json",
49:     language: "json",
50:     extensions: [".json"],
51:     command: "vscode-json-languageserver",
52:     args: ["--stdio"],
53:     installHint: "npm install -g vscode-langservers-extracted",
54:   },
55:   {
56:     name: "css",
57:     language: "css",
58:     extensions: [".css", ".scss", ".less"],
59:     command: "vscode-css-languageserver",
60:     args: ["--stdio"],
61:     installHint: "npm install -g vscode-langservers-extracted",
62:   },
63: ];
64: 
65: /**
66:  * Detect which LSP server to use based on file extension.
67:  */
68: export function detectLSPServer(filePath: string): LSPServerConfig | undefined {
69:   const ext = filePath.slice(filePath.lastIndexOf("."));
70:   return BUILTIN_LSP_SERVERS.find((s) => s.extensions.includes(ext));
71: }
